scope: Two decided defects: (1) leaveGroupImpl has no execution-time sole-admin re-check, so two co-admins leaving at nearly the same moment can strand a group with zero admins; (2) the invite picker labels a not-yet-confirmed (invited, pending) member 'already in group'.

behavior.leave_recheck: leaveGroupImpl reads mlsGroup.groupData.adminPubkeys (own try/catch, twin of the member read) after the member read and BEFORE the kind-13/kind-9 sends, tombstone and purge. If members are known, the leaver is not the last member, and the leaver is the sole admin (case-insensitive), it returns false having done nothing. Otherwise unchanged and returns true.
behavior.fail_direction: Same as the member read: unknown/throwing admin read, null groupData, unknown member list, or no MLS group never abort (purge must never be skipped; undeletable-group failure F1). Last member who is sole admin still abandons.
behavior.ui_surface: MarmotContext.leaveGroup passes the boolean through; LeaveGroupButton treats false as aborted: no navigation, modal switches to the existing 'blocked' state showing copy.groups.lastAdminLeaveBlocked (resolveLeaveModalState). Reset on re-open.
behavior.picker: selectableContactsForGroup accepts optional confirmedPubkeys; a member outside it gets disabledReason 'invite_pending' (case-insensitive); confirmed members keep 'already_member'; without the signal all members stay 'already_member'. getInviteReasonText maps it to groups.inviteReasonInvitePending: en 'invitation pending', de 'Einladung ausstehend'. groups.tsx passes confirmedPubkeys only when non-empty (empty = not yet loaded).

constraints: No new publish of anything; no privacy surface touched
en+de copy in i18n.ts via useCopy
No jsdom: logic tested through pure functions
Do not touch app/src/lib/reactions/ or docs/behavior/reactions-and-emoji.md
non_goals: Closing the residual both-pass-before-either-departure window (documented, accepted)
Resend / cancel+re-invite of a pending invitee
